notes: Frame: model metres, +X east, +Y grid north. Standing water in the Village, read from the NJ 2020 ortho (0.15 m/px) on gridded sheets at zoom 14 to 25 and checked against the LiDAR ground. Water levels come from the build (terrain.shore_level: the 10th percentile of the ground every metre along the traced shore) unless a surface gives `level`. The stormwater basin's pond: its west half holds water in the ortho (dark blue-green, with a few bright specks of floating growth); the shore was found by casting rays from inside the water to the first metre of grass colour, then drawn as straight runs with true-arc corners. The LiDAR returns over it are classed ground and flat (98.90 to 99.11 m, 10th to 90th percentile 98.93 to 99.11); the traced shore reads 99.04 m. The basin's grass floor (V_road_Basin_floor, v_roads) stays under it. The pool by the Abbott and Costello Center: a rectangle 18.3 x 11.1 m turned 53.6 deg, fitted to the corners of the teal water in the ortho (its four corners agree to about 0.3 m); a light concrete deck surrounds it inside a fence. The LiDAR has ground returns on the pool level with the deck (112.6 to 112.8 m), so the pool's water is drawn flush with the deck.

surfaces.name: V_water_Basin_pond
surfaces.evidence: ortho2020 (water colour, rays from inside the water to grass), lidar (flat ground returns 98.9 to 99.1 m)
surfaces.unverified: a detention basin's waterline moves with the weather: this is the extent on the 2020 ortho; the east lobe (x -334 to -329, y 1186 to 1196) is water mixed with wet growth

surfaces.name: V_water_Village_pool_deck
surfaces.unverified: deck edges read from the ortho to about 0.5 m: the fence round it and shrubs blur them; drawn as a rectangle 4 to 4.5 m out from the pool, parallel to it; the fence is not modelled

surfaces.name: V_water_Village_pool
surfaces.evidence: ortho2020 (rectangle fitted to the corners of the teal water), lidar (returns on the pool at deck level)
surfaces.unverified: the water is drawn flush with the deck: the step down from the coping (usually about 0.15 m) is not modelled; layer 5.5 puts the pool over its concrete deck
